order_wins: **GPT Infraprojects** — wins a **Rs 483.72 crore contract including GST from Rail Vikas Nigam** for a 32-span open-web steel girder bridge over the Mahanadi on the Nergundi-Barang third and fourth line, in 1,095 days _(~33.7% of mcap)_.

**Diamond Power Infrastructure** — receives a **purchase order worth about Rs 263.25 crore including GST from a domestic EPC contractor** for power cables and conductors on an MSEDCL urban project in Bhandup _(~1.1% of mcap)_.

**Jain Irrigation Systems** — receives an **MSEDCL letter of empanelment for 5,000 off-grid solar water pumps under the Magel Tyala scheme, Rs 117.96 crore including GST**, within 60 days _(~5.7% of mcap)_.

**Softtech Engineers** — wins a **Rs 92.95 crore Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority project for an AI-enabled digital twin and 24x7 command-and-control centre**, delivered with Dassault Systèmes' platform _(~14.1% of mcap)_.

**RailTel Corporation of India** — receives a **Prasar Bharati letter of intent, estimated at Rs 63.15 crore including tax**, for additional features and services on the WAVES OTT platform, to February 2029.

**Captain Polyplast** — receives an **MSEDCL order for 2,000 off-grid solar water pumps worth about Rs 47 crore including GST** under PM-KUSUM B, its largest solar EPC order, for installation in 60 days _(~12.5% of mcap)_.

**Om Power Transmission** — receives a **Rs 40.69 crore letter of award excluding GST from Hild Projects** to build and commission the 220kV AIS switchyard for NTPC's 600 MW Bhuj solar plant in 10 months _(~7.1% of mcap)_.
**GRE Renew Enertech** — reports **seven ground-mounted solar EPC orders worth Rs 25.56 crore including GST received 1-15 September**, the largest Rs 6.29 crore, from customers it does not name.
**Ceinsys Tech** — receives **two orders from T Second Inc., USA, totalling US$25,12,500 (Rs 24.10 crore at the filing's rate)** for 32TB drives and AI change-detection services _(~1.7% of mcap)_.

**Univastu India** — receives a **Rs 23.74 crore work order including GST from Larsen & Toubro** to supply and commission the CCTV system for Mumbai Metro Lines 4 and 4A, over 67 weeks _(~4.5% of mcap)_.

**Fabtech Technologies** — secures a **Rs 21 crore turnkey project for a medical-device plant's cleanroom and utility infrastructure in an unnamed CIS country**, its first in that market, for handover in about 12 months.
**Affordable Robotic & Automation** — receives a **Rs 11.06 crore purchase order from an undisclosed domestic customer** for a turnkey robotic welding line, delivery by March 2027 _(~5.8% of mcap)_.

**Purple Wave Infocom** — receives a **Rs 5.10 crore work order excluding GST from IT Infrastructure Park (CRC)** for LED media-wall and audio systems at its flagship Noida project, in 180 days _(~1.4% of mcap)_.

**Marvel Decor** — receives a **Rs 4.15 crore repeat purchase order from an international customer** for motorised roller blinds using its own Solis motors, for delivery within three months _(~3.9% of mcap)_.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services** — board approves **up to 1,30,26,516 shares and 1,89,47,664 warrants at Rs 985.17 for Rasmalai Limited of Cyprus, up to Rs 3,150 crore for 24.87% fully diluted**, subject to shareholders; its press release names Advent International _(~33.3% of mcap)_.

**OnEMI Technology Solutions (Kissht)** — board approves a **preferential issue of up to 2,64,93,882 shares at Rs 314.11 to 34 non-promoter investors, up to Rs 832.20 crore**, with an EGM set for 14 October _(~13.7% of mcap)_.

**Kalind** — board **withdraws its Rs 316.02 crore warrant issue and approves 8,60,86,956 shares at Rs 11.50 to SRM Global Infrastructure, Orange AI Tech and EROC Colorant instead, Rs 99.00 crore** _(~108.9% of mcap, our arithmetic)_.
**String Metaverse** — board approves **8,32,03,383 shares at Rs 8.85 on a preferential basis, Rs 73.63 crore**, with an EGM on 15 October _(~7.5% of mcap)_.
**Bharat Forge** — **opens its qualified institutional placement at a floor price of Rs 1,947.70 a share**, with up to a 5% discount permitted; the filing does not state the issue size.
equity_allotments: **Neogen Chemicals** — allots **26,60,753 QIP shares at Rs 2,255 to qualified institutional buyers, Rs 599.99 crore**, taking its share count to 3,00,42,427; the issue closed on 16 September.

**Ind-Swift Laboratories** — allots **70,00,000 fresh warrants at Rs 196 to promoter-group Essix Biosciences**, receiving Rs 34.30 crore as the 25% upfront; full conversion would be Rs 137.20 crore _(our arithmetic)_.

**Marble City India** — allots **30,00,000 fresh warrants at Rs 100 to promoters Saket and Amit Dalmia**, Rs 30 crore on full conversion within 18 months, with Rs 7.50 crore paid upfront _(our arithmetic)_.

**Pelatro** — board approves **7,00,000 fresh warrants at Rs 400, Rs 28 crore**, to ten allottees including promoters Varun and Kiran Menon and Invicto Incrementum Fund, exercisable over 18 months _(~7.2% of mcap)_.

**Onida Electronics** — allots **73,86,362 fresh warrants at Rs 35.20 to Resonance Opportunities Fund, Nexta Enterprises and Aamara Capital, Rs 26.00 crore**, on Rs 6.50 crore of 25% upfront money _(~2.2% of mcap)_.
**Commercial Syn Bags** — allots **16,13,000 shares at Rs 72 to promoter-group holders on converting March-2025 warrants**, receiving Rs 8.71 crore of balance money.
**Alan Scott Enterprises** — allots **9,52,931 partly paid rights shares at Rs 75**, collecting Rs 3.81 crore of application money at Rs 40 a share, with Rs 35 to be called.
**Vardhman Polytex** — allots the **balance 37,50,000 shares at Rs 12.55 to promoter-group Oswal Holding on converting March-2025 warrants**, receiving Rs 3.53 crore; none now remain unconverted.

**Hemo Organic** — receives the **second tranche of Rs 2.76 crore from Vacro Enterprises and Qmin Realities on 34,00,000 outstanding warrants**, which on conversion would double its share count to 68,65,900.
**Eco Hotels and Resorts** — converts **18,39,573 partly paid rights shares to fully paid on Rs 1.56 crore of call money**, after a final reminder-cum-forfeiture notice extended to 31 August.
m_and_a: **Sanofi India** — promoter-group Sanofi Healthcare India agrees to **buy up to 35,00,000 shares, up to 15.20%, from promoter Hoechst GmbH** on or after 24 September as an open-offer-exempt inter-se transfer; the price is not fixed.
**Share India Securities** — **completes the purchase of all of Enshrine Leasing and Infotech for Rs 39.72 crore**, making the 1,25,463-share company wholly owned from 17 September _(~0.8% of mcap)_.
**QMS Medical Allied Services** — buys the **remaining 24% of subsidiary Saarathi Healthcare for Rs 14.23 crore in cash**, taking it to wholly owned _(~4.4% of mcap, our arithmetic)_.
**Indus Infra Trust** — **completes the purchase of controlling interest and substantially all equity in KNR Guruvayur Infra from KNR Constructions**; the consideration is not stated in this filing.

**Standard Capital Markets** — the **NCLT Kolkata approves its resolution plan for Paymark Payment Technologies & Services** under Section 31, pronounced on 8 September; the consideration is not stated.
**Rudra Ecovation** — the **NCLT Chandigarh sanctions its merger into Shiva Texfabs**, pronounced on 16 September; the certified order is awaited.

**Swan Defence and Heavy Industries** — the **amalgamation of Triumph Offshore takes effect on 17 September** on filing the certified NCLT Ahmedabad order with the registrar, with 1 April 2024 as the appointed date.
**Roto Pumps** — receives the **NCLT Allahabad first-motion order for the amalgamation of wholly owned Roto Energy Systems** into the company, pronounced on 15 September.
**Vipul** — board grants **in-principle approval to merge six wholly owned subsidiaries into itself** under the Section 233 fast-track route; no consideration or swap is stated.
**NLC India** — wholly owned NLC India Renewables **incorporates NIRL PTC Renewables with PTC India on a 74:26 split** to build green-energy projects, certified on 16 September.

**Petronet LNG Limited** — Petronet LNG Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates - approval of proposal for incorporation of 50:50 joint venture company between PLL and Gruner Renewable Energy Private Limited
**Transworld Shipping Lines** — signs a **joint venture with Dubai's Bainbridge Navigation DMCC to run a UAE Handysize dry-bulk pool**, taking 60% for AED 75,000 against Bainbridge's 40%.

**HEG** — promoter-group LNJ Spark Advisory reports an exempt allotment lifting **promoter and promoter-group holding in HEG Advanced Materials from 56.28% to 60.72%** under the composite scheme; no consideration is disclosed.

**Shivalic Power Control** — signs a share purchase agreement to **buy 51% of Seedlab Ventures for Rs 1.43 lakh**, a related-party deal taking it into solar-park development; Seedlab turned over Rs 2.49 crore in FY26.

**HandsOn Global Management** — board approves **subscribing US$579,997 (Rs 5.57 crore per the filing) for 204,946 shares of Nasdaq-listed XBP Global at US$2.83**, 1.45% post-issue, a related-party deal.

**DB (International) Stock Brokers** — board approves **transferring its major client business — trading, depository participant, mutual fund and other financial products — to a prospective buyer yet to be identified**, subject to an EGM.

**Crizac** — cuts its **Edument Consultancy consideration to Rs 1.24 crore for 5,337 compulsorily convertible preference shares** after a shareholder withdrew consent, trimming the expected stake to about 36.80% from 37.41%.

**ABH Healthcare** — signs a **non-binding MoU to take over the 50-bed Sri Kailash Multi Speciality Hospital, Sri Ganganagar, on a 15-year lease-and-manage basis** by 31 October; consideration to be agreed.

**Seamec** — wholly owned SEAMEC International FZE **completes the sale of the bulk carrier SEAMEC Gallant** on signing the protocol of delivery and acceptance; buyer and consideration are not disclosed.

**Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail** — wholly owned Aditya Birla Digital Fashion Ventures **buys a further 15.62% of Imperial Online Services, taking it from 84.38% to wholly owned**, in cash under a July 2022 agreement whose price the filing does not restate.

**Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail** — subsidiary Sabyasachi India **incorporates wholly owned Sabyasachi Retail FZ-LLC in Ras Al Khaimah** with 3,458 shares of AED 1,000, to sell designer apparel and jewellery.
**Tipco Engineering India** — forms **51%-owned Tipco Defence Technologies & Robotics for Rs 51,000**, with its chairman and managing director holding the other 49%.
capex_core: **Asian Paints** — **starts commercial production of vinyl acetate ethylene emulsion at Dahej, Gujarat, on 1,50,000 tonnes a year of installed capacity**, mainly for its own paint plants; the VAM and ethylene facilities are still being built.
**Alpex Solar** — **inaugurates its 2.2 GW G12R TOPCon solar cell plant at Kosi Kotwan, Mathura**, a 9 lakh sq ft facility that backward-integrates its module business.

**ACME Solar Holdings** — subsidiary ACME Greentech Seventh **commissions Phase II of 52.32 MW / 209.28 MWh of battery storage at Kelan, Bikaner** under an SJVN power purchase agreement, taking the project to 105.95 MW / 423.80 MWh of 300 MW / 1,200 MWh.

**Juniper Green Energy** — subsidiary Juniper Green Beam Eight **fully commissions its 75 MW wind-solar hybrid project** under a Tata Power purchase agreement by adding the last 25 MW of solar, lifting group capacity to about 2,725 MWp.

**Time Technoplast** — **completes its Rs 24 crore greenfield polymer-pail plant at Bhilad, Gujarat**, a fully robotic 6,000-tonne facility it expects to turn over about Rs 100 crore at 90% utilisation, with production from 25 September.

**Precision Wires India** — **begins trial production of copper cathodes at its Zaroli copper refining and recycling plant**, with commercial production expected in the third quarter subject to final approvals.
**Monolithisch India** — subsidiary Metalurgica India **begins dry runs at its greenfield plant, with commercial production from 10 October**.

**Orient Green Power** — material subsidiary Beta Wind Farm **awards Renfra Energy India a Rs 62 crore turnkey EPC contract including GST for two 3.3 MW wind turbines at Karur**, pushing commissioning to 30 November.

**Unihealth Hospitals** — board approves **quitting direct hospital operations at UMC Zhahir in Nigeria and redirecting the unutilised Rs 1.69 crore of IPO proceeds** to Indian subsidiary UMC Hospitals for expansion, subject to shareholders.
**Invicta Diagnostic** — **starts CT scanning at its Shegaon centre and pathology at Pune**, investing about Rs 60 lakh and Rs 10 lakh from company funds.
business_updates: **Results season** — 10 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.

**Puravankara** — **secures redevelopment rights for three Bangur Nagar societies in Goregaon West, Mumbai**, 4.68 acres and about 1.05 million sq ft, at an estimated gross development value of Rs 2,600 crore.
**Prestige Estates Projects** — **launches Garden Breeze at The Prestige City, Sarjapur, Bengaluru**: 655 apartments across 10 acres, estimated gross development value Rs 1,100 crore.
**Tata Motors** — **raises commercial-vehicle prices by up to 1% from 1 October** to offset commodity and input costs.

**Aimtron Electronics** — step-down subsidiary Aimtron International Controls **books US$11.8 million of orders this quarter**, against a quarterly average below US$4 million, and adds five customers it does not name.

**MosChip Technologies** — **completes the initial silicon bring-up of its VIDYUT100 smart energy meter chip**, taped out in the first quarter under MeitY's design-linked incentive scheme; commercial availability awaits validation.
**Wipro** — **launches Wipro STO360, a shutdown and turnaround management solution on SAP's platform, with Aramco and SAP**, Aramco being the first to implement it; no contract value is given.
**HCL Technologies** — **launches HCLTech Pulse, a business unit for enterprises with US$500 million to US$5 billion of revenue**, to scale AI adoption.
**Eicher Motors** — Royal Enfield's **Flying Flea C6 electric motorcycle launches in Paris, Barcelona, Rome, Berlin and London**, bookings from EUR 5,990 and GBP 5,300, deliveries by October.
**LG Electronics India** — **enters India's chest-freezer market with six convertible models** from 102L to 530L for retail, dairy and food-storage businesses.
**Lemon Tree Hotels** — **opens the 80-room Lemon Tree Premier, Jabalpur**, five more rooms than it disclosed in January 2023, run by wholly owned Carnation Hotels.
**PVR INOX** — **opens a three-screen multiplex with 352 Sapphire seats at DLF Summit Plaza, Gurugram**; the capex is not disclosed.

**Kothari Industrial Corporation** — **enters beverages with CHUSIP Coco Twist tender coconut water, launched in Chennai at Rs 50 for 200 ml**; its Rs 2,500 crore figure is a 2035 ambition, not a booking.
**Sunita Tools** — **receives another advance-payment tranche under its interim sales agreement for NATO-spec 155mm M107 empty shells**; neither the tranche nor the customer is named.

**Central Mine Planning & Design Institute** — board approves a **five-year umbrella MoU with Oil India on clean energy and critical minerals**, which the filing says carries no direct financial commitment, plus a coal-gasification MoU with CSIR-CIMFR.
**Ganesh Consumer Products** — says the **company whose FSSAI licence news reports described as suspended is an unconnected entity**, and that it has received no such notice or order.
distress_risk: **Smaart Tech Services** — **Kripa Anand Rishi Cellular demands repayment of a Rs 129.50 crore inter-corporate loan plus 9.83% interest within 10 days**, threatening legal action _(~39% of mcap, our arithmetic)_.

**G R Infraprojects** — **NTPC invokes a Rs 49.53 crore mobilisation-advance bank guarantee and three surety bonds worth Rs 41.34 crore**, Rs 90.86 crore in all, a day after the company terminated its NTPC battery-storage contracts _(our sum; ~1.1% of mcap)_.

**Oberoi Realty** — the **Punjab and Haryana High Court revives its order barring further allotments at Three Sixty North, Gurugram** until a 25 September hearing; the company says the Rs 7,891 crore already booked is unaffected and construction is not stayed.
**Bharat Immunologicals & Biologicals** — says the **Government of India has approved its closure**; the company is under the Department of Biotechnology.

**Jamna Auto Industries** — the **appellate commissioner confirms Rs 3.53 crore of a Rs 4.06 crore input-credit demand**, with Rs 46.58 lakh of interest and penalty; the company will appeal and expects no material impact.
**Bhansali Engineering Polymers** — receives a **Rs 79.66 lakh penalty order for assessment year 2018-19** over research and other expenditure deductions, which it plans to appeal.

**Astron Paper & Board Mill** — tells the exchanges its **first-quarter results cannot be finalised because the suspended management has not handed over records**, and that it has applied under Section 19(2); insolvency began on 11 May.
**Priority Jewels** — the **appellate commissioner deletes the 2011-12 additions and drops penalty proceedings**, cutting a Rs 3.54 crore tax demand, with a refund of amounts paid due.

**Kalpataru** — the **GST authority appeals to the GST Appellate Tribunal against relief granted to subsidiary Abacus Real Estate** on a Rs 1.36 crore transitional-credit demand; no material impact expected.
**SKIL Infrastructure** — its **11th committee-of-creditors meeting under insolvency is adjourned again, to 21 September**.
open_offers: **GSL Securities Ltd** — open offer PA (PA is scanned — open the filing); mcap Rs 17 cr
credit_rating_changes: **SG Mart** — CRISIL **upgrades its Rs 940 crore of bank facilities to AA-/Stable and A1+ from A and A1**, removing the positive watch after control passed to Sanjay Gupta of APL Apollo.
**Coastal Corporation** — CARE **lifts its bank facilities out of default, to CARE B+/Stable and A4 from CARE D**, across Rs 68.28 crore and Rs 273.50 crore of limits.
**ESDS Software Solution** — CRISIL **upgrades its long-term facilities to A-/Positive from BBB+/Positive and short-term to A2+ from A2**.
**Centum Electronics** — CARE **upgrades it to CARE BBB+/Stable and A2 from BBB/Positive and A3+**, citing the divestment and liquidation of its loss-making UK entities.
**P N Gadgil Jewellers** — CRISIL **upgrades its Rs 400 crore of bank facilities and Rs 50 crore fixed-deposit programme to A+/Stable from A/Positive**.
**Century Extrusions** — Infomerics **revises its long-term outlook to IVR BBB/Positive from IVR BBB/Stable** and reaffirms IVR A3+ on the short term.
other_notable: **Emami** — board approves an **open-market buyback of up to Rs 282 crore at a maximum Rs 475 a share**, at least 75% of it to be spent, promoters excluded _(~1.8% of mcap)_.

**Gandhi Special Tubes** — **completes the extinguishment of 8,68,100 shares bought back by tender at Rs 900, Rs 78.13 crore**, cutting its share count to 1,12,83,900 and promoter holding to 71.70% _(our arithmetic; ~7.2% of mcap)_.
**Responsive Industries** — board **decides not to proceed with its proposed buyback**, citing market conditions, global uncertainty and the effect on its export business.

**Mega Nirman and Industries** — **withdraws its rights-issue application and draft letter of offer** filed with the exchange, pending a review of the objects and use of proceeds; the size was never disclosed.
**La Opala RG** — promoter Genesis Exports **buys 2,00,000 shares on market for Rs 3.21 crore**, lifting its holding to 47.25% from 47.07%.
**Arur Footwear** — receives a request from promoter-group entity ExpertPro Realty to be **reclassified as public, covering 9,83,675 shares or 5.00% of capital**.
